coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API HTTP 400 error, resulting in an inconclusive verdict for that file.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent a single API failure from causing an entire package audit to be marked as inconclusive.
